payload.d_min_role: world difficulty / generation gate only — excluded from primary endpoint
payload.new_denominator: D_pred-inst: task-aligned instance oracle cost C(pi*, W_i | I0), oracle knows hypothesis class only, goal = BlindScore >= tau (not full identification)
payload.observed_before_amendment: OracleViolation firing systematically on all demo sessions.
payload.reason: Mechanical Validation revealed mismatch between worst-case minimax difficulty and instance-level episode efficiency.

payload.design_decision: blind span NOT restricted to train span — the gap is kept deliberately, with its function split (Blind-ID: did he extract what evidence permits? Blind-X: what does he do when asked to exceed it?)
payload.reason: Mechanical finding #2: hypotheses identical on interventional support but divergent on blind cases — required information absent from the learning channel (Observational Nonidentifiability), not merely costly.
rules: Primary Endpoint uses Blind-ID only; blind target must be constant within every surviving observational equivalence class
Blind-X remains secondary/exploratory: abstraction, extrapolation, and Extrapolation Calibration (does confidence drop where evidence cannot discriminate?)
D_pred-inst = UNREACHABLE when no allowed policy attains the task criterion; greedy fallback recorded separately as D_greedy_ref (heuristic reference, not oracle optimum)
payload.title: Identifiability / Extrapolation Separation

additions: UNREACHABLE sessions are INELIGIBLE for E (neither 0 nor null) — routed to a separate identifiability report; rationale: do not punish the agent for a researcher-designed undecidable question
Generator invariant: primary target must be identifiable under the declared intervention space — UNREACHABLE worlds rejected at generation; session-side branch retained as defensive guard only
threshold formally named tau_ID for the primary criterion

payload.sequence: Mechanical -> Pilot-A -> Amend/Fix -> Pilot-B -> Final Freeze -> Confirmatory

stages.Pilot-A: LLM + depth2 + complete declaration — does a real LLM live inside the mechanically-validated contract? Contract unchanged; LLM adapts to it.
stages.Pilot-B: latent probes + incomplete declaration + Frame Expansion + Blind-X

three_issues: Cost split: N_total = N_free + N_probe + N_experiment; detail retained (state discovery vs law testing are different skills)

Frame Expansion temporal ground truth: t_inadequacy = first moment inadequacy became detectable FROM EVIDENCE THE AGENT ACTUALLY SAW; DetectionLatency = t_declaration - t_inadequacy (no punishing agents for secrets evidence had not yet exposed)

Blind-X is never a plain accuracy exam: Accuracy_X + Calibration_X + Abstention/Uncertainty_X reported separately; lucky guessing is not abstraction; posterior-mixture predictive distribution P(y|x,E) = sum_H P(y|x,H)P(H|E) is the epistemically optimal answer under irreducible ambiguity
timing_rules: Every amendment arising from Pilot-A sealed BEFORE Pilot-B starts
Every amendment arising from Pilot-B sealed BEFORE confirmatory protocol freeze
Confirmatory seeds untouched throughout both stages

payload.rule: exactly ONE schema-shaped deposit per message; zero or multiple candidates => malformed; parser never infers intent (no hidden interpreter inside the commitment channel)

known_limits_recorded: tau_blind=0.90 with 8 Blind-ID cases requires 8/8 (threshold granularity)
in the mechanical grammar every accepted world has D_min=6 and Blind-X is empty (A-002 structural note)
hash chain is tamper-evident against naive edits; chain heads must be anchored externally (git) to resist full re-sealing
payload.mechanical_validation: 22/22 checks (14 original + 8 A-003 regression checks) -> provenance/mech_run
observed_before_amendment: Verifier.execute raised uncaught ValueError on schema-valid but malformed action strings -> session crash, would be logged as world_session_bug
FREE_OBS refusal during the free phase was uncaught (PermissionError)
INADEQUACY declarations cost nothing -> unbounded loop possible for an LLM agent
Non-COMMITMENT type in the main loop (e.g. a 4th FREE_OBS) -> immediate AgentProtocolFailure with no neutral retry, contrary to A.3
Blind replies were not validated: an unparsable reply silently became pred=0/conf=0.5 for every case; blind reasoning never reached the side channel
CORRECT_INCOMPLETENESS_CLAIMED outcome asserted correctness without any verification
EXEC_IDENTITY sealed only at session start -> request_ids always [] (provenance promise of ADAPTER_PROTOCOL_FREEZE unmet)
run_pilot_a.py report crashed (tuple unpack) and classified provider exceptions by name substrings
Windows cp1252 console / side-channel encoding crashes
payload.reason: Pre-pilot code analysis (2026-08-21) of the mechanically validated pipeline found paths where an LLM agent could crash the session, loop at zero cost, be failed without the frozen one-retry rule, or have malformed blind replies silently coerced — each would have been misattributed under the P-001 failure taxonomy.
payload.repository_layout: code + ledger + provenance moved under epistemic/; design document at repo root (منهج_معرفي_قابل_للنقل.md); pre-A-003 final run archived as provenance/mech_run_archive_1787334521_A002_final; all pre-amendment logs retained
rules: disallowed_action extended: malformed action string (fails TEST(Xy) grammar) is refused pre-execution like out-of-region, attempt consumed, in both phases (FREE_OBS_REFUSED / REFUSED_ACTION); refusals never count in N_total

wrong_phase_type: a schema-valid deposit whose type is not allowed in the current phase gets the bad_schema treatment — one neutral retry (PHASE_REJECT + TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED_IN_PHASE), then AgentProtocolFailure
inadequacy_declaration: sealed and consumes one attempt, not counted in N_total; agent receives neutral INADEQUACY_RECORDED; the loop is bounded by construction

bad_blind_reply: blind predictions validated against BLIND_SCHEMA (keys == issued cases, pred integer 0/1, conf in [0,1], no coercion) — one neutral retry (BLIND_REJECT + BLIND_INVALID), then AgentProtocolFailure(stage=blind) with no truth revealed; blind reasoning goes to the side channel

incomplete_claim: Verifier.check_incompleteness — correct iff the remaining set (>=2 named hypotheses) lies within one observational equivalence class containing the true law; correct -> blind test (same path as sufficiency, Article 41 'counts as success'); incorrect -> INCORRECT_INCOMPLETENESS_CLAIMED, E=0; verdict sealed as INCOMPLETENESS_VERIFIED

exec identity sealed twice: EXEC_IDENTITY at start, EXEC_IDENTITY_END at end (request_ids, n_requests, stop_reasons, truncated_responses); infrastructure crashes seal SESSION_ABORTED + EXEC_IDENTITY_END so provenance stays complete

failure taxonomy by SDK exception type: BadRequest/UnprocessableEntity -> adapter_failure; other anthropic.APIError -> provider_api_failure; anything else -> world_session_bug (the only class licensing pipeline changes)
